description: Build the 5-tx Transfer saga. Agent supplies equality (320 B) + validity-3H (544 B) + range U128 (1000 B) proofs + auditor lo/hi ciphertexts (64 B each) + new AES decryptable (36 B), plus the three ephemeral ctx-state pubkeys.

auditorCiphertextHi.description: Base64 of the high 32 bytes of the auditor ElGamal ciphertext.

auditorCiphertextLo.description: Base64 of the low 32 bytes of the auditor ElGamal ciphertext.

destinationTokenAccount.description: A Solana address in base58, 32-44 chars.

equalityContextAccount.description: A Solana address in base58, 32-44 chars.

equalityProof.description: Base64 of the ciphertext-commitment equality proof from your ZK worker.

mint.description: A Solana address in base58, 32-44 chars.

newSourceDecryptableAvailable.description: Base64 of the 36-byte AES-encrypted post-transfer source balance your worker computed.

owner.description: A Solana address in base58, 32-44 chars.

rangeContextAccount.description: A Solana address in base58, 32-44 chars.

rangeProof.description: Base64 of the range proof from your ZK worker.

validityContextAccount.description: A Solana address in base58, 32-44 chars.

validityProof.description: Base64 of the batched ciphertext-validity proof from your ZK worker.
